paragraphs.text: On 29 September 2026, more than 200 people met in Naples, Italy, to discuss links between space technology and the maritime sector. Ports, coastguards, companies and research organisations were represented. The European Space Agency, or ESA, organised the event with the Italian Space Agency. ESA reported the meeting on 1 October and announced a new Space for Ports Working Group.
paragraphs.translationJa: 2026年9月29日、宇宙技術と海事分野のつながりを話し合うため、200人を超える参加者がイタリアのナポリに集まった。港湾、沿岸警備隊、企業、研究機関の関係者が参加した。欧州宇宙機関（ESA）がイタリア宇宙機関と共同で開催し、10月1日の報告で新たな「Space for Ports Working Group」の設立を発表した。

paragraphs.text: A port connects ships with roads, businesses and surrounding communities. Improving its operations can therefore involve several organisations rather than a single company. At the meeting, speakers discussed safety, logistics and digital connections. They stressed that a useful service must answer an operational need and work with systems that ports already use. An attractive technology alone is not enough.
paragraphs.translationJa: 港は船と道路、企業、周辺地域をつなぐ。したがって業務の改善には、一社だけでなく複数の組織が関わることがある。会議では安全、物流、デジタル接続が議論された。役立つサービスには現場の必要性への対応と既存システムとの連携が必要だと強調された。魅力的な技術だけでは十分ではない。

paragraphs.text: ESA describes three ways satellites can help at sea. Communication satellites link offshore activities to people on land. Navigation systems help ships determine their position. Earth observation provides images and other information about the surface. These services perform different tasks; combining them does not mean that one satellite replaces every piece of equipment used by a port.
paragraphs.translationJa: ESAは海上で衛星が役立つ方法を三つ説明している。通信衛星は沖合の活動と陸上の人々を結ぶ。航法システムは船の位置確認を助ける。地球観測は地表の画像や情報を提供する。それぞれ役割は異なり、組み合わせれば一つの衛星で港のあらゆる設備を代替できるという意味ではない。

paragraphs.text: For example, ESA lists environmental monitoring among the uses of Earth observation. It can support coastal planning, help assess a port's environmental impact and detect oil spills. Satellite communication also supports search and rescue. These are examples of possible applications across the maritime sector, not a claim that every port has adopted all of them or achieved identical results.
paragraphs.translationJa: たとえばESAは、地球観測の用途に環境の監視を挙げている。沿岸の計画、港の環境への影響の評価、油の流出の発見などを支援できる。衛星通信は捜索・救助にも役立つ。これらは海事分野での活用例であり、すべての港が導入済みで同じ成果を上げたという主張ではない。

paragraphs.text: The new group will let ports share priorities and identify common challenges. It also aims to connect port users with the space community and develop practical initiatives. ESA wants promising services to move beyond demonstration into deployment. This is a plan for cooperation, not evidence that the group has already reduced waiting times or lowered costs. Its value will depend on what participants can put into practice.
paragraphs.translationJa: 新組織は、港湾が優先事項を共有し、共通の課題を見つける場となる。港の利用者と宇宙分野を結び、実用的な取り組みを進めることも目指す。ESAは有望なサービスを実証から実際の導入へ進めたいと考えている。これは協力の計画であり、すでに待ち時間や費用を減らした証拠ではない。価値は参加者が何を実現できるかにかかっている。

comprehension.question: What was announced after the Naples meeting?
choices: A group connecting ports with space services.
A company replacing every port authority.
A rule closing all ports during satellite tests.
A system banning ships without satellite links.

evidence.text: ESA reported the meeting on 1 October and announced a new Space for Ports Working Group.

comprehension.question: Why can the group's success not yet be assumed?
